subject: Kickoff: DPOK fine-tuning for the image-gen stack
body:
Hi both,

Kicking off DPOK adoption for agents-rl. The method from our open-source release fine-tunes text-to-image diffusion models with online policy-gradient RL, using a reward model (ImageReward in the release) plus a KL term to keep the policy anchored — the knobs are reward_weight and kl_weight, and the reference config uses reward weight 10 with KL weight 0.01.

Why we care as product: our internal image-gen demo consistently loses side-by-sides on prompt fidelity. DPOK is the cheapest lever we have — no new base model, just RL fine-tuning against our internal preference reward model.

Milestones: single-prompt training reproduced on our stack by end of March, multi-prompt runs through April, a Launch Review Board slot for the improved demo in mid-May (sign-off is required before we show it externally).

Alina owns staffing and the money conversation for the scale-up.

Ulla
